subject: VMWARE_ESXI_REFERENCE_GOVERNANCE
statement: The repository mechanically traces every VMware experiment from Tech Story to representative VMware run and hash-bound VMware evidence, derives non-closing acceptance associations from requiredTechStories, keeps QEMU controls under a distinct typed subject, and binds the schema-valid V17 canonical result plus its non-closing O4/g101 black-box summary.
limitations: Historical pyVmomi task identifiers and initiating actors are not uniformly retained.

Historical VMware runs do not all conform to contracts/vmware-experiment-result.schema.json; VMW-AER-COR-001 now has a schema-valid V17 canonical result, but its full raw bundle remains a separately retained local artifact.
Representative run IDs do not imply that every legacy case has a canonical result.

The QEMU AER root-sequence run remains a separately typed reference positive control and is not VMware evidence. V17 establishes only the exact ESXi O4/g101 root-state slice; O0, other gates, notification/service attribution, guest writes, lifecycle recovery, and physical health remain unverified.
Derived acceptance links remain non-closing associations; this index is traceability evidence, not case completion evidence.
This reference-governance result cannot close a Qman product case, risk, implementation milestone, qualification profile, or release gate.
